original: さて、今回の仕事についてだけど、\nルバーブ連山の山頂に行ってもらうね
traducao: Now then, regarding your next job,\nhead to the Rhubarb Mountains summit.

original: 山頂には数年前に隕石が衝突していて、\nその隕石の欠片があるかもしれないの。\nそれを入手してきてちょうだい
traducao: A meteorite struck the summit years ago,\nand fragments of it might remain.\nPlease go retrieve them for us.

original: 隕石に含まれる、ギベオンっていう鉱物が\n必要なのよ
traducao: I need a mineral found in meteorites\ncalled Gibeon!

original: あんたが持つディセンダーの浄化能力を\nヒトに転写する為にね
traducao: To transfer your Descender purification\nability into ordinary humans!

original: でも、危険な試みなんでしょう？
traducao: Still, isn't that a dangerous venture?

original: 私達がやんなきゃ、誰がやるのよ
traducao: If we don't do it, who will?!

original: そうね。\n準備だけでも進めた方がいいかなぁ…
traducao: True.\nWe should at least make preparations...

original: じゃあ、説明を続けるね
traducao: Well then, let me continue.

original: 同行者は、レイヴンさんとアスベル君
traducao: Accompanying you are Raven and Asbel.

original: 山頂へのルートは、霧がかかってる事が\n多いけど、今日なんて気候の条件もいいし\n運良く霧が晴れているかもしれないよ
traducao: The route to the summit is usually foggy,\nyet conditions are favorable today,\nso with luck, the fog may have cleared!

original: それじゃあ、気を付けて行ってらっしゃい
traducao: Well then, take care and off you go!

original: いつもは山頂に霧が濃く掛かっているが、\n今日はそこまで見通しは悪くなさそうだ
traducao: Usually thick fog blankets the summit,\nyet visibility seems alright today.

original: おっさん、暑い所は平気だけど\nああいうさむーい所は勘弁願いたいわ
traducao: Old guys like me don't mind heat, but\nI'd rather skip such freeeezing places.

original: それにしても隕石ねえ…
traducao: Still, a meteorite, eh...?

original: この御天道さんの向こうにゃ、\n世界樹から生まれた\n色んな世界があるんだろうねぇ…
traducao: Beyond that sun up in the sky,\nthere're probably all kinds of worlds\nborn from the World Tree...

original: ああ、宙と言うのは本当に広い。\nどこまで俺達は繋がっているんだろう…
traducao: Indeed, the heavens are truly vast.\nHow far do our connections reach...?

original: しかし、奇妙なものだ
traducao: Yet it is truly strange.

original: かつてはエステリーゼ様…いや、\nエステルを連れ戻す為に\nあなたを追っていたのに
traducao: Once I pursued you\nto bring back Lady Estellise...\ner, Estelle.

original: 今やこうして共に旅する仲間、ってか。\n数奇なもんだねぇ
traducao: And now we're travel companions, eh?\nFate's a strange thing indeed.

original: 霧が少ない…。\n今日は山頂まで進めそうだ
traducao: The fog is thin...\nWe should reach the summit today.

original: 山の天気は変わりやすいって\n言うじゃなーい？
traducao: Don't they say mountain weather\ncan change in a flash?

original: コレ、戻れなくなったりなんて\nしないでしょうね
traducao: We won't end up stranded and unable\nto get back, right?

original: …確かに。\nなら、ペースを上げよう。\nよし、行くぞ！
traducao: ...True enough.\nThen let us pick up our pace.\nAlright, let's go!

original: ちょ、ちょっと待ってよ！\nおっさんに山道はしんどいって！
traducao: H-Hold on a second!\nMountain trails are killer on an old guy!

original: あー、もう！　置いてかないでよ〜
traducao: Aah, seriously! Don't leave me behind~!

original: おぉ〜…、道が険しい上に\n空気も薄くなってきたわよ
traducao: Oof... On top of this steep trail,\nthe air's gettin' thin as well!

original: しかも容赦無く襲ってくる魔物…。\n年寄りにはちとキツイよ、これは
traducao: And monsters attack without mercy...\nThis is rough on an old codger!

original: ギルド歴は長いんだろう？\nこういう仕事は慣れているのではないのか？
traducao: You've been in guilds a while, right?\nAren't you used to this kind of work?

original: そりゃおたくみたいに若い頃は\n出来たかもしらんよ
traducao: Maybe when I was young like you,\nI could handle it no problem.

original: ところでおたく、ギルドは楽しいかい？
traducao: By the way, kiddo, you enjoyin' the guild?

original: 複雑そうな顔するねぇ。\nやっぱ、騎士団に戻りたい？
traducao: Look at that conflicted face.\nWanna head back to the Knights after all?

original: 俺は…大切なものをこの手で守る為に、\n騎士の道を選んだ。\nそして、守っている気になっていた
traducao: I chose knighthood to protect\nwhat's precious with my own hands.\nAnd I thought I was protecting them.

original: うんにゃ、少なくともガルバンゾ国を\n守る事には貢献してたでしょ。\n騎士だもの
traducao: Nah, at least you helped\ndefend the Kingdom of Garbanzo.\nYou were a knight, after all.

original: 守る一方で、守る為に他の命を\n奪う事もあった
traducao: While protecting, I also took other lives\nin order to protect.

original: そして、エステルの話を聞いて、\n俺は何も守れていない事を知った
traducao: And hearing Estelle's words, I realized\nI had protected nothing at all.

original: 騎士になっただけでは、駄目だったんだ
traducao: Just becoming a knight wasn't enough.

original: ま、ユーリもそうやって\n騎士団を辞めたんだ
traducao: Well, that's the same reason\nYuri quit the Knights too.

original: 騎士団じゃあ、あいつの信念は\n通せなかったんだろうねえ
traducao: Guess he couldn't see his beliefs\nthrough inside the Knights.

original: どんな人にも守るべきものがある。\n国という枠を越えて、\n全てのヒトは守られなければならない
traducao: Everyone has things to protect.\nBeyond the borders of nations,\nall humans must be protected.

original: アドリビトムに来なければ\nきっと、それに気付けなかった…
traducao: If I hadn't come to Ad Libitum,\nI never would have realized that...

original: ま、今のゴタゴタが終わったら\n帰りな。\nエステル嬢ちゃんを連れてな
traducao: Well, once this mess is over,\nhead on back.\nAnd take little Estelle with ya.

original: 国に戻れば、\n全ての人を助けられない
traducao: If I return home,\nI cannot save everyone.

original: イカンね〜、勉強した事は\n役に立たせてこそ意味があるのよ
traducao: No good, kid! What you learn\nonly has meaning if put to use.

original: 国や騎士団を変えるなら、\nおたくみたいな人が必要なの
traducao: To change your country and Knights,\nfolks like you are what's needed.

original: ははは。\nまあ、しっかり悩んどけよ、青年
traducao: Hahaha.\nWrestle with it all you like, youngster.

original: ひ〜…。\nやっと山頂と思ったら、\nお出迎えだわねぇ
traducao: Gaaah...\nJust when we reach the summit,\nwe get a welcoming committee!

original: 来るぞ！
traducao: Here it comes!

original: うひゃ〜…、\n向こうはやる気満々じゃないの
traducao: Yikes~...\nThey're rarin' to go, aren't they?!

original: 一気に片を付ける。\n前回の様にはならない！
traducao: We settle this at once!\nIt won't go like last time!

original: そのテンション、わけて欲しいわ〜
traducao: I wish you'd share some of that energy~

original: さてと。\nギベオンとやらはどいつかな
traducao: Now then.\nWhich one might this Gibeon be?

original: …表面に、独特の網目模様がある
traducao: ...It has a unique lattice pattern.

original: 隕鉄の特徴を備えている。\n恐らく、こいつだ
traducao: It bears the traits of meteoric iron.\nThis must be it.

original: んじゃ、欠片でもいいって話だから\nちょこっと削って持ってきゃいいわね
traducao: She said fragments were fine, so let's\nchip off a piece and bring it back.

original: 宙からの贈り物か…
traducao: A gift from the heavens, huh...?

original: これは、どこかの世界の一部だったかも\nしれないんだな
traducao: This might once have been a part\nof some other world out there.

original: 宙を隔てても、世界を越えても、\n命は支えあっていくものかもしれない
traducao: Across the void, across worlds,\nlife may be meant to support each other.

original: 俺達も…、遠い世界に何かをして\nあげれる様になれるだろうか
traducao: Can we too become able to do something\nfor distant worlds, I wonder...?

original: そうありたいねえ
traducao: Sure'd be nice if we could.

original: 生きて、命を繋いで、その先のまたずっと先の\n子孫が意志を継いでくれる世界になる様に\n頑張りましょ。　俺達がね
traducao: Let's live, pass on life, and build\na world where descendants carry our will.\nYou and me both.

original: ま、今は目の前の難題をどうにかする事が\n先だわねぇ…
traducao: Handling the trouble before our eyes\ncomes first, though...

original: ギベオンの採取、お疲れ様。\n霧が晴れていて幸いだったね
traducao: Good work retrieving the Gibeon.\nWe're fortunate the fog cleared!

original: これからは山頂方面の探索も可能なはずよ
traducao: Exploration toward the summit is open now.

original: んじゃ、\nギベオンはいただいてくわよ〜ん
traducao: Alrighty!\nI'll take the Gibeon off your hands~!

original: これからディセンダーの能力転写の\n実験を行える様にするから。\nそれまで時間ちょうだいね
traducao: I'll prep the Descender ability\ntransfer experiment now.\nGive me a little time, okay?

original: ねえ、○○
traducao: Hey, ○○.

original: ディセンダーのドクメントを\n転写させる実験の準備が出来たからって、\nハロルドさんが呼んでるよ
traducao: Harold is calling for you.\nPreps for the Descender Document\ntransfer experiment are complete!

original: 研究室へ来てだって
traducao: She said to come to the lab.

original: 被験者にするって、おい！！\n俺は、ゴメンだぜ！！
traducao: Make me the test subject?! No way in hell!\nNot on your life!

original: ぶ〜…、\nあんた以外に誰がやりゃいいのよ〜。\n信用されて無いわねぇ…
traducao: Booo~...\nWho else am I supposed to use?\nNobody has any faith in me...

original: するか！
traducao: Like hell I do!

original: お前いっつも俺の脳ミソ調べるとか、\n顔をすげ替えるとか、\nそんなんばっかりじゃねえか！！
traducao: You're always probing my brain\nor swapping out my face!\nIt's always crazy crap like that!!

original: あ、来てくれたわね
traducao: Ah, you made it!

original: 早速、実験に移りたいんだけど\n被験者がいなくってねー
traducao: I want to jump right to testing,\nbut we lack a test subject~

original: 仕方ないわね。\nあたしが被験者になるわ
traducao: Can't be helped.\nI'll be the test subject.

original: ダメよ。\nドクメントの転写作業は、\nあんたの力も必要なの
traducao: No good.\nThe Document transfer work\nneeds your power too.

original: 私一人じゃ、制御出来ないもの
traducao: I can't control it all alone, you see.

original: そうは言っても、\n誰もこんな役やりたがらないわよ。\nどうすんの？
traducao: Even so,\nnobody will want this role.\nWhat are you going to do?

original: …あのっ
私がやるよ。\n…ダメ、かな？
traducao: I'll do it.\n...Would that be no good?

original: 待てよ！\n失敗したら、\n死ぬかもしれねぇんだぞ！
traducao: Hold on!\nIf it fails,\nyou could freaking die!

original: おい、被験者はヒトじゃないと駄目なのか？\n他にもっと方法探せねぇのかよ
traducao: Hey, does the subject have to be human?!\nCan't you find another way?!

original: 何かを得るのに、それなりのリスクがあるのは\n当たり前でしょう？
traducao: Taking a fair share of risk to gain\nsomething is obvious, isn't it?

original: 何も傷付けずに、望みを叶えようなんて悩み、\n心が贅沢だから出来るのよ
traducao: Agonizing over granting wishes without\nhurting a thing is a luxury of the heart!

original: 助かるわ〜。\nじゃ、この天才を信じて任せなさい★
traducao: What a lifesaver~!\nLeave it to this genius and trust me!

original: うん。\n私は平気
traducao: Yeah.\nI'll be fine.

original: ○○と繋がるだけだもの。\n恐くなんかないよ
traducao: We're only connecting with ○○.\nI'm not scared at all!

original: じゃあ、二人で\nこの「トランスクリプタ」に立って！
traducao: Now then, you two stand on this\n'Transcriptor'!

original: じゃあ、始めるわよ
traducao: Alright, let's begin!

original: はい！
traducao: Right!

original: これが○○…、\nディセンダーのドクメントね
traducao: So this is ○○'s...\nthe Descender's Document.

original: 転写、開始！
traducao: Transcription, initiate!

original: …ぁ………あああ…
私ね…、最も…ステキな事を…\n今から起こすんだ…
traducao: I'm going to make... the most wonderful...\nthing happen right now...

original: 未来を創るんだよ…。\n未来を…みんなで…創るんだ…
traducao: We'll create the future...\nWe'll create the future... together...

original: みんながあなたの様に、\n希望を灯していける様な未来を…
traducao: A future where everyone can kindle hope,\njust like you...

original: みんなが、輝ける様に…
traducao: So everyone... can shine...

original: カノンノ、身体はどう？
traducao: Kanonno, how is your body feeling?

original: 少しふわふわするけど、\n大丈夫みたい…
traducao: I feel a bit light-headed,\nbut I seem okay...

original: ねえ、実験は成功したわけ？
traducao: Hey, did the experiment succeed?

original: 成功はしてるはずだけど、\n確認が必要ね
traducao: It should be a success, but\nwe need verification.

original: カノンノに能力が転写されているか、\n試してみないと何とも…
traducao: Unless we test whether the power was\ntransferred to Kanonno, I can't say...

original: カノンノの疲労もあるから、\nすぐには無理ね
traducao: With Kanonno fatigued, we can't test\nimmediately.

original: そうね。\nカノンノは、\nしばらく医務室で休ませるわ
traducao: Right.\nI'll have Kanonno rest in\nthe infirmary for a while.

original: 私は、平気だよ…
traducao: I'm... quite alright...

original: 無茶されて、倒れられた方が迷惑なの
traducao: Collapsing on us is far more troublesome!

original: というわけで、\n検証はカノンノが回復してからね
traducao: So verification will wait\nuntil Kanonno has recovered.

original: あんたも実験に協力してくれて\n感謝するわ
traducao: Thanks for your cooperation in\nthe experiment too!

original: カノンノが治療のため、医務室に収容されます
traducao: Kanonno rests in the infirmary for care.

original: カノンノがパーティから外れました
traducao: Kanonno has left the party.

original: カノンノの状態、もう大丈夫よ
traducao: Kanonno's condition is fine now.

original: アニーも、もう大丈夫って言ってたし\n試しに行ってもらいたいの
traducao: Annie said she's all better too,\nso I'd like you to go test it.

original: 今からアンジュに依頼として届けるけど、\nあんたが行くの。\nわかった？
traducao: I'm sending the request to Ange now,\nand you're the one going.\nUnderstood?

original: じゃあ、あとは頼んだから
traducao: Well then, I leave the rest to you.

original: カノンノの治療が終了しました
traducao: Kanonno's treatment is complete.
